name: iloader
one_liner: A free desktop app that makes it easier to install unofficial apps and jailbreak-adjacent tools onto an iPhone by handling the technical pairing steps for you.
buyer: No real paying buyer — this serves hobbyists in the iOS sideloading community who expect free, open-source tools and would resist any paywall.
business_use_cases: A device-repair shop could offer 'app sideloading setup' as an add-on service to walk-in customers, using the tool to do the technical work.
A tech YouTuber creates sponsored tutorial content around it to drive channel growth, monetizing the audience rather than the tool.
A niche hardware accessory seller (e.g., pairing cables, dev boards) cross-promotes to the same enthusiast audience.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid, hands-on remote setup sessions for less technical users who don't want to do it themselves.

steal_this: This is a free community utility, not a product to clone for profit — the honest weekend project is a paid 'we'll do it for you' concierge sideloading service, not the software itself.
